array.guards: first and last pages PROT_NONE; every middle-page byte outside array remains 0xa5
array.runtime_address: Fresh per process, recorded in li2_run; no cross-run pointer normalization or full-state equivalence inferred

compiler_profile.all_actual_header_dependencies: Complete actual depfile must be authenticated by root; system header/compiler/runtime identities are fresh observations
compiler_profile.observed_historical_version: GCC 11.5.0, recorded by closed elf-exec-e6243a8-v1/tools.json; not a new observation

elf.cet: disabled prospective profile, no CET qualification
elf.stripping_contract: Same LOAD geometry/bytes except explicit ELF section-table coordinates; retain exact original identities separately
elf.unwind: ordinary compiler unwind sections retained; rewritten unwind not qualified

hooks.core_null: li2_null_hook(const void *context), read/write no context fields
hooks.core_record: li2_record_hook(const void *context), reads only HookContext.instruction_pointer at offset0; writes only journal
hooks.e9_address: Required LI2_JOURNAL_ADDRESS macro equals exact original li2_journal ELF symbol; no default or external lookup; shared stripped pair must retain address
hooks.e9_null: passthru for primary null comparison; optional li2_e9_null(uint64_t pc) is a separately labeled null-call ABI control
hooks.semantics: One logical-PC row per selected instruction visit before instruction; null means no journal writes; machine code and hook ABI wrappers may differ

journal.application_check: Exact header/guards, active0, count<=capacity, overflow0/fault0/reserved0, zero unused tail; raw file is written before returning invariant failure
journal.fault: Header failure sets fault=1; inactive call sets fault=2; nonzero fault/overflow blocks further PC writes. Full run refuses.
journal.overflow: When count>=16384, set sticky overflow=1 without writing any PC or advancing count. Full run refuses.
journal.runtime_expectation: Original/null runs require external count0/zero PCs; recording runs require exact complete selected-site PC sequence derived from the original baseline, including legitimate zero-visit empty/singleton heap-write cells
journal.tail_unused: All PC slots after count remain zero
journal.writer: Single-threaded volatile word stores; PC then count, no atomic/concurrent claim

kernel.all_heads: Complete decoder inventory including every nonselected verified head; no success filtering
kernel.caller_bounds: n<=64; sift_down root<n/2 implies 2*root+1<n, right child tested <n; root/child and heap_sort end-1 stores remain below original n
kernel.calls: Only direct calls among the three kernel functions plus returns; actual decoder must enforce this initial closure
kernel.heap_write_complete: Only the admitted array_store explicit write; all other explicit/implicit writes in all kernel functions must be owned RSP-relative stack writes with no index, including CALL pushes. Any other writer is retained as unsupported and refuses complete inventory.
kernel.heap_write_scope: All array writes during the sorting kernel, excluding declared initialization, output, runtime and instrumentation-private writes outside that range
kernel.jump_style: Every conditional/unconditional jump in full kernel ranges, excluding CALL/RET; exact instruction family policy from both decoders must agree
kernel.ranges_rule: Actual ELF symbol-sized ranges, nonoverlapping and wholly RX .text; enclosing span contains only the three functions and decoded alignment padding; no hidden clone/helper

store_abi.expected_compiled_body: MOV qword ptr [RDI+RSI*8], RDX; RET, no displacement or segment override

run_record.boundary_semantics: Ordinary noipa compiled calls with memory barriers; no child trap, state seed or runtime tracer

phases.1: owned array seeded, journal active, before sort
